title: PartitionPolicy v1 — the partition law as data: a split mesh never answers a task twice (duplicate_answers_allowed is always false — a second execution across a seam is reconciled by task id, never delivered as a second answer), healing always merges the CRDT stores (merge_on_heal is always true), and the duplicate-execution winner is chosen by one deterministic rule — the offerer's own side's result first, then the earliest finish, then the canonically smaller claimant name — so every node settles the same contest the same way regardless of merge order; a policy naming any other law fails validation (Y-058)
